effects.rationale: This policy restricts the ability of parents to obtain licenses and permits. This is a restriction on access to resources.
This policy could impact small businesses that rely on state-issued permits and licenses. This is a restriction on access to resources.

evidence_quote: Deny or suspend state-issued permits and licenses to parents who are delinquent in paying court-ordered child support.
review_reason: This policy directly restricts access to resources for parents who fail to pay child support. This is a restriction on access to resources.
